title: Flagging a news photo for a sensitive-content warning
scenario: A news publishing app runs every article image through a Gemini classifier before it goes live, asking only whether the photo needs a sensitive-content warning; here it reviews a traffic-accident scene photo.

$ai_input.content:
You moderate images attached to news articles before publish.

Look at the attached image and decide whether it needs a sensitive-content warning.

Flag as needing a warning if the image shows:
- Graphic injury, visible blood, or a body
- A weapon pointed at a person
- A disaster scene with visible casualties

Do not flag for:
- A crowd, a protest, or a courtroom with no visible injury
- Property damage alone (a burned building, a wrecked car with no visible people)
- A photo of officials, politicians, or spokespeople

Return only JSON: {"explicit": true or false}. No other text, no explanation.

When genuinely unsure, prefer false; an editor reviews every article before it goes live regardless of this flag.
